Body.Content:
Updated November 4, 2026: We have updated the timeline. Thank you for your patience. 

What and Why:

Microsoft Purview eDiscovery is introducing three read-only diagnostic checks for case access, security filters, and hold-policy distribution. These checks help admins understand and troubleshoot common access, search-scoping, and hold-distribution issues directly in the product.

This message is associated with Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 565222

Rollout Schedule:

Public Preview (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out in early December 2026 (previously late October) and expect to complete by mid-December 2026 (previously mid-November).

General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out in late December 2026 (previously early December) and expect to complete by early January 2027 (previously mid-December 2026).

General Availability (GCC): We will begin rolling out in late December 2026 (previously early December) and expect to complete by mid-January 2027.

General Availability (GCC High): We will begin rolling out in late December 2026 (previously early December) and expect to complete by early February 2027.

General Availability (DoD): We will begin rolling out in late December 2026 (previously early December) and expect to complete by late February 2027.

Impact on Your Organization:

Who is affected:

  • eDiscovery admins.

What will happen:

  • Admins can use three read-only diagnostics to understand common issues with case access, search scoping, and hold-policy distribution.
  • The diagnostics provide guidance without changing your organization's existing configuration.

Action Required/Recommendations:

No admin action is required at this time. Review your eDiscovery workflows and internal guidance if your organization uses the related Microsoft Purview capabilities.

  • Learn about access and permission settings in eDiscovery cases (role/permission troubleshooting)
  • Security-filter diagnostic
  • Hold-distribution diagnostic

Compliance considerations:

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.

Title: Microsoft Purview | eDiscovery: In-product diagnostics to troubleshoot common challenges
